text:
carla: up for a sunrise kayak + bakery run Sunday? thinking 7am launch, 9am carbs :croissant:

mike: i'm in if weather holds. which beach are we doing? Pier 7?

carla: yep Pier 7 — tide chart looks friendly. low tide launch should be easy.

jani: tempted but got a family brunch. can I still join y'all at the bakery around 9:30?

sam: count me in on the paddling side. i can bring a French press and spare thermos. call time 6:50 so we're rigged by 7?

nisha: i'll pass on the paddle this time but bluebird bakery on 4th is my vote for pickups — they open 8am though.

carla: good call. plan: 7am launch at Pier 7 for paddlers, then Bluebird (or second option Harbor Oven) for everyone ~9:15-9:30.

mike: i can bring a pump and an extra life jacket. also FYI the marina lot fills fast — street parking on Harbor Ave sometimes better.

jani: perfect. i'll meet y'all at Bluebird ~9:30. pls ping when you leave the lot or if running late.

sam: Quick note: if wind >12mph we'll move to plan B = coffee + board games at my place. i'll post a weather check at 5:30am.

carla: :thumbsup: locking it in. 6:50 @Pier 7 lot, kayaks launched 7:00. Bluebird pickup ~9:15-9:30. ping here if anything changes.

nisha: have fun folks! pls post pics — love the sunrise shots :camera_with_flash:
